performance_indicators.statement: Demonstrate knowledge of mathematics, science, and engineering fundamentals relevant to the discipline.
Apply mathematical and scientific principles to formulate engineering problems.
Use domain-specific engineering knowledge to solve complex problems.
Identify and formulate complex engineering problems from real-world scenarios.
Review relevant research literature to contextualize engineering problems.
Analyze engineering problems using first principles and reach substantiated conclusions.
Design system components or processes that meet specified needs and constraints.
Incorporate public health, safety, and environmental considerations in design.
Develop solutions for complex engineering problems using systematic design methodology.
Design and conduct experiments to investigate complex engineering problems.
Analyze and interpret experimental data using appropriate tools and techniques.
Synthesize information from multiple sources to draw valid conclusions.
Select and apply appropriate modern engineering tools and techniques for complex activities.
Use computational and IT tools for modeling, prediction, and simulation.
Understand the limitations and capabilities of modern engineering tools.
Assess societal, health, safety, and legal issues relevant to professional practice.
Apply contextual knowledge to evaluate the impact of engineering solutions on society.
Recognize the responsibilities of engineers in addressing cultural and societal needs.
Understand the environmental impact of engineering solutions.
Demonstrate knowledge of sustainable development principles.
Apply sustainability considerations in engineering design and practice.
Apply ethical principles in professional engineering practice.
Commit to professional responsibilities and norms of engineering practice.
Recognize ethical dilemmas and apply appropriate ethical reasoning frameworks.
Function effectively as an individual contributor in engineering projects.
Collaborate as a member or leader in diverse and multidisciplinary teams.
Demonstrate interpersonal skills necessary for effective teamwork.
Communicate effectively through written reports and design documentation.
Make effective technical presentations to diverse audiences.
Comprehend and articulate complex engineering concepts clearly.
Apply engineering and management principles to project planning and execution.
Demonstrate financial and resource management skills in engineering projects.
Lead and manage teams in multidisciplinary project environments.
Recognize the need for continuous professional development.
Engage in independent learning activities to stay current with technological change.
Demonstrate ability to acquire new knowledge and skills beyond formal education.
Engage in research activities to contribute to the advancement of engineering knowledge.
Apply creative problem-solving and original thinking to engineering challenges.
Conduct experimentation and innovation to develop novel engineering solutions.
